description: Delete a sprint of a project's board. Its issues — of every project — go back to the backlog, each with a line in its history; nothing else of them changes. To end a sprint that ran, complete it with complete_sprint instead: completing keeps the sprint and its done issues in the record, deleting does not. Answers 'released', how many issues left it. Needs full write access to the project (member, admin or lead); a reporter, a commenter or a read-only member is refused with the reason, as is anybody while the project is paused or archived. Written in the project's journal under your name.

projectKey.description: Project key whose board holds the sprint, e.g. 'PM'.

sprint.description: The sprint, by name or id from list_sprints. A name is matched exactly; give the id when in doubt.

name: delete_sprint
title: Delete sprint
